subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw invite — shareable invite codes for mobile pairing

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a cloud-backed mobile invite-code discovery surface now, or should bare short-code discovery wait for the broader Cloud Relay trust/config design?
rationale: The issue is technically concrete but cannot be safely resolved by code search alone because it adds backend-mediated Gateway discovery, new config, and auth-adjacent mobile pairing behavior.

options.title: Defer to Cloud Relay design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the invite-code discovery subproblem and settle backend ownership, config, abuse controls, and security requirements with the broader Cloud Relay work before implementation.

options.title: Approve a narrow invite resolver
options.body: Allow a focused design/PR for `openclaw invite` if maintainers explicitly accept the cloud endpoint contract, config shape, expiry, one-time-use, and rate-limit/security requirements.

options.title: Reject core cloud invites
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers want remote mobile discovery to remain outside OpenClaw core or rely only on QR/setup-code, Tailscale, and plugin-hosted integrations.

recommendation.title: Defer to Cloud Relay design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the invite-code discovery subproblem and settle backend ownership, config, abuse controls, and security requirements with the broader Cloud Relay work before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current QR/setup-code and Gateway bootstrap paths point to recent work by steipete, and the decision crosses core config, setup UX, and security defaults.
